title: A domain purchase Vercel may have completed is held for an operator, not refunded

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), domains review of #3240 (LIVE-781) and #3328 (LIVE-786).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: recordDomainPurchaseFromSession refunded the Space on every registrar error, including 'network' (the fetch threw) and 'upstream' (a 5xx, an unknown code, or a 200 with no order id). Those can mean Vercel registered the domain, so Frequency would pay for a domain the Space was refunded for and never bound. The renewal path in the same feature already treats these errors as ambiguous. Latent: domain_purchase_enabled is off. Also, a failed write of the bought order left the row in 'purchasing' with no order id anywhere. THE FIX: on 'network' or 'upstream' the row stays 'purchasing' with failure_reason set, so the daily sweep raises registration-submission-unknown for an operator; definitive refusals still refund. The post-buy write is error-checked and logs the order id. Test in domain-purchase.test.ts.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/sites/domain-purchase.ts','utf8');if(!/bought\.error === 'network' \|\| bought\.error === 'upstream'/.test(s)||!/return 'purchasing'/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-821: an ambiguous registrar error refunds a domain Vercel may have registered');process.exit(1)}"
